Definition: from G2570 and G1320; a teacher of the right:--teacher of good things.
BiblicalUsage: Kalodidaskalos is a teacher of good things — the charge given to the aged women, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that teaching good things is a calling for the older women of the church, and the home is the first classroom where the faith is taught.
